title: Syrian-Style Flatbread
description: A traditional flatbread originating from Syria, often served with various dips and spreads. This recipe is a simplified version of the authentic dish.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
2. Gradually add water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
6. Divide the dough into 4-6 equal portions, depending on the desired size of flatbreads.
7. Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
8. Brush the tops with olive oil and cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and puffed.
9. Serve warm with your favorite dips or spreads.
